content.title: DILAN ITB 1997
content.writer: Pidi Baiq, Adhitya Mulya, Ninit Yunita
content.player: Ariel Noah, Niken Anjani, Raline Shah, Della Dartyan, Wafda Saifan, Lubis, Rangga Natra, Dany Beler, Ira Wibowo, Qibil The Changcuters, Arya Saloka, Denny Chandra, Maya Hasan, Rina Hassim, Tarzan, Hasyakyla Utami, Reybong
content.synopsis: In 1997, Dilan (Ariel Noah) is in a relationship with Ancika (Niken Anjani) while trying to complete his studies at the Faculty of Art and Design (FSRD) at ITB and build a name for himself as a reliable freelance artist. As Dilan and Ancika’s relationship begins to grow more serious, two women enter Dilan’s life and put their relationship to the test—one of them coming from Dilan’s past.

content.title: GHOST IN THE CELL
content.player: Abimana Aryasatya, Aming, Arswendy Bening Swara, Bront Palarae, Danang Suryonegoro, Dewa Dayana, Endy Arfian, Kiki Narendra, Lukman Sardi, Morgan Oey, Rio Dewanto, Tora Sudiro
content.synopsis: Inside Labuan Angsana, one of the country’s most notorious prisons, survival is already a daily nightmare. Rival gangs and crooked, abusive guards leave little room for hope. But when an unseen force begins slaughtering inmates one by one, the prison descends into chaos. Now, killers, thieves, and conmen must do the unthinkable: work together to survive. Terrifying, bloody, and unexpectedly hilarious, Ghost in the Cell is a claustrophobic horror-comedy where no cell is safe — and laughter may be the last defence against the dark.

content.title: SALMOKJI: WHISPERING WATER
content.player: Kim Hye-yoon, Lee Jong-won, Kim Jun-han, Kim Young-sung, Oh Dong-min, Yoon Jae-chan, Jang Da-a
content.synopsis: An incident that unfolds when a filming team goes to a reservoir to update the road view where an unidentified figure was filmed and encounters something in the dark, deep water.

content.title: MORTAL KOMBAT II
content.producer: Todd Garner, E. Bennett Walsh, James Wan, Toby Emmerich, Simon McQuoid
content.writer: Jeremy Slater, Ed Boon, John Tobias
content.player: Joe Taslim, Karl Urban, Adeline Rudolph, Jessica McNamee, Josh Lawson, Ludi Lin, Mehcad Brooks, Tati Gabrielle, Lewis Tan, Damon Herriman, Chin Han, Tadanobu Asano, Hiroyuki Sanada
content.synopsis: From New Line Cinema comes the latest high-stakes installment in the blockbuster video game franchise in all its brutal glory, Mortal Kombat II.  This time, the fan favorite champions—now joined by Johnny Cage himself—are pitted against one another in the ultimate, no-holds barred, gory battle to defeat the dark rule of Shao Kahn that threatens the very existence of the Earthrealm and its defenders.

content.title: AYAH, INI ARAHNYA KEMANA, YA?
content.player: Rey Bong, Mawar De Jongh, Dwi Sasono, Unique Priscilla, Baskara Mahendra, Kiara Mckenna, Dinda Kanya Dewi, Azami Syauqi
content.synopsis:
A young girl grows up in the same household as a father who is always present, yet never truly there. When a family crisis forces her to carry adult responsibilities, she must lear. 

Dira (Mawar De Jongh) and Darin (Rey Bong) grow up under the roof of “Soto Bu Lia,” a home turned eatery that appears warm from the outside but is filled with silence words left unspoken and promises that are constantly broken. Yudi (Dwi Sasono) is there, but his presence never offers direction. Lia (Unique Priscilla) works tirelessly, concealing debt and family wounds to keep the family looking whole for her children. Their early memories are sweet and simple, yet beneath the Everything changes when a incident a brutal stove explosion shatters the family’s routine. 

Lia is severely injured, and the household’s main support collapses. The home turns into an emergency infirmary as medical expenses rise. That moment opens the door to long- hidden fragility, mounting debt, concealment, and truths that can no longer be covered with a smile. From then on, a family life once driven by routine is thrust into crisis, and Dira is pulled to the front line of the struggle.

content.title: THE DEVIL WEARS PRADA 2
content.player: Meryl Streep, Anne Hathaway, Emily Blunt, Stanley Tucci, Simone Ashley, Justin Theroux, Kenneth Branagh, Rachel Bloom, Lucy Liu, Lady Gaga, Caleb Hearon, Tracie Thoms
content.synopsis: As Miranda Priestly (Meryl Streep) nears retirement, she reunites with Andy Sachs (Anne Hathaway) to face off against her former assistant turned rival: Emily Charlton (Emily Blunt).

content.title: AIN
content.producer: Raam Punjabi, Yuda Wirafianto, Pandu Adiputra
content.player: Britanny Fergie, Putri Ayudya, Bara Valentino
content.synopsis: After a childhood spent being ignored due to her weight, 35-year-old Joy Putri (Britanny Fergie) has finally found the spotlight as a glamorous beauty influencer. Her goal is simple: 10,000 Live viewers. However, her obsession with perfection draws a warning from her old friend, Dini (Putri Ayudya), who fears Joy is inviting the "Evil Eye"—a curse born of envy. Joy ignores the superstition, choosing fame over caution, until the curse takes hold. In a terrifying reversal of her "flawless" image, Joy’s body begins a gruesome and disgusting transformation that no filter can hide.

content.title: YANG LAIN BOLEH HILANG ASAL KAU JANGAN
content.player: Lulu Tobing, Ibnu Jamil, Yasmin Napper, Sofia Shireen, Jourdan Omar
content.synopsis:
Kesha (Yasmin Napper) mahasiswi tingkat akhir sekolah film punya seorang ibu. Ibunya bernama Yuke Yolanda (Lulu Tobing), Guru favorit di Sekolah tempat ia mengajar dan juga Ibu yang sangat dicintai oleh Suami (Ibnu Jamil) dan anak-anaknya. Masalah datang ketika ada sesuatu yang terjadi pada Yuke. Yuke mulai sering lupa, lupa ulang tahun pernikahan, lupa jalan ke sekolah sampai hal-hal penting tentang ketiga anaknya, Kesha, Kenya dan Karlo. Rumah yang awalnya hangat penuh kebahagiaan, kini berubah semakin parah. Kesha yang sedang fokus dengan tugas akhir kini berada dalam pilihan paling sulit: tetap bertahan mengejar impiannya atau pulang dari kosannya sebelum ia benar-benar hilang dari ingatan Ibunya. Karena ada hal-hal yang boleh hilang dalam hidup — kesempatan, nilai, bahkan mimpi. Tapi jangan sampai kita yang hilang dari hati dan ingatan seorang Ibu.

Yang Lain Boleh Hilang, Asal Kau Jangan.

content.title: IKATAN DARAH
content.player: Livi Ciananta, Derby Romero, Ismi Melinda, Teuku Rifnu Wikana, Abdurrahman Arif, Ramadhan Ruswadi, Agra Piliang
content.synopsis:
MEGA (Livi Ciananta), a former Pencak Silat champion now scraping by as a waitress, is forced back into the fight of her life when her brother, BILAL (Derby Romero), becomes the target of the city’s most ruthless gangsters—after a debt gone bad and a killing he never meant to commit.

Hunted and outnumbered, the siblings are cornered in a neighborhood where every exit has been sealed by the henchmen of feared crime boss PRIMBON (Teuku Rifnu). With nowhere left to run, Mega and Bilal must stand their ground and fight their way out.

content.title: MICHAEL
content.producer: John Branca, Graham King, John McClain
content.player: Jaafar Jackson, Colman Domingo, Nia Long, Kendrick Sampson, Miles Teller, Juliano Krue Valdi, Joseph David-Jones, Jamal Henderson, Jessica Sula
content.synopsis: Discover the story of Michael Jackson, one of the most influential artists the world has ever known, and his life beyond the music. Tracing his journey from the discovery of his extraordinary talent as the lead of the Jackson Five, to the visionary artist whose creative ambition fueled a relentless pursuit to become the biggest entertainer in the world. Highlighting both his life off-stage and some of the most iconic performances from his early solo career.

content.title: THE BELL: PANGGILAN UNTUK MATI
content.player: Bhisma Mulia, Ratu Sofia, Maulidan Zuhri, Givina Lukita Dewi, Syalom Razade, Mathias Muchus, Septian Dwi Cahyo, Nabil Lunggana
content.synopsis:
Di Pulau Belitung, kepercayaan terhadap hal-hal mistis masih hidup di tengah masyarakat modern. Salah satunya adalah sebuah lonceng keramat yang selama ratusan tahun dijaga oleh garis keturunan dukun untuk mengurung roh-roh jahat. 

Namun ketika lonceng itu dibunyikan oleh orang yang tidak memahami risikonya, sebuah teror pun terlepas. Penebok sosok setan tanpa kepala yang dikenal haus tumbal kini kembali dan mulai menghantui desa, menyebarkan ketakutan yang tak bisa dijelaskan. 

Teror tersebut memaksa Danto (Bhisma Mulia), yang telah lama meninggalkan Belitung, untuk pulang. Bersama Airin (Ratu Sofia) dan Hanafi (Maulidan Zuhri), ia terjebak dalam upaya melawan kekuatan tak kasat mata yang berakar pada kepercayaan lama dan rahasia yang belum sepenuhnya terungkap.

content.title: BILLIE EILISH: HIT ME HARD AND SOFT - THE TOUR LIVE IN 3D
content.player: Billie Eilish, James Cameron, Finneas O'Connell, Maggie Baird
content.synopsis: Captured during Billie Eilish sold-out world tour, a concert experience from one of the most celebrated and successful artists of her generation, presented in immersive 3D.

content.title: LEE CRONIN'S THE MUMMY
content.producer: James Wan, Jason Blum, John Keville
content.player: Jack Reynor, Laia Costa, May Calamawy, Natalie Grace, Veronica Falcon, Shylo Molina, Billie Roy
content.synopsis: Hot off the record-setting resurrection of EVIL DEAD RISE, writer/director Lee Cronin turns to one of the most iconic horror stories of all time with an audacious and twisted retelling: LEE CRONIN’S THE MUMMY. The young daughter of a journalist disappears into the desert without a trace—eight years later, the broken family is shocked when she is returned to them, as what should be a joyful reunion turns into a living nightmare.

content.title: FUZE
content.producer: Gillian Berrie, David Mackenzie, Sebastien Raybaud
content.player: Aaron Taylor-Johnson, Theo James, Gugu Mbatha-Raw, Sam Worthington, Honor Swinton Byrne, Saffron Hocking, Luke Mably, Elham Ehsas, Atul Sharma
content.synopsis: An unexploded WWII bomb is discovered on a busy construction site in the centre of London. Chaos ensues as the military and police begin a mass evacuation against a ticking clock.

content.title: PROJECT HAIL MARY
content.producer: Ryan Gosling, Phil Lord, Christopher Miller, Amy Pascal
content.player: Ryan Gosling, Sandra Huller, Lionel Boyce, Ken Leung, Milana Vayntrub, Liz Kingsman
content.synopsis: Science teacher Ryland Grace wakes up alone on a spaceship light-years from Earth. As his memory returns, he uncovers a mission to stop a mysterious substance killing the sun, and save Earth. An unexpected friendship may be the key.

content.title: SHAKA OH SHAKA
content.producer: Chand Parwez Servia, Riza, Mithu Nisar
content.player: Kiesha Alvaro, Arla Ailani, Artika Sari Devi, Vira Yuniar, Joshua Suherman, Maisha Kanna, Dennis Adishwara, Teuku Ryzki, Amel Carla, Adzana Ashel, Mazaya Amania, Altaaf Akavi
content.synopsis:
A chance meeting at a concert changes everything. Ocel, a modest college student, never expects that a single moment will lead her into a relationship with Shaka—her idol, admired by thousands. 

What begins as admiration slowly grows into a love that strengthens them both. Together, they navigate dreams, differences, and the realities of their contrasting worlds. But as time moves forward, life begins to test their bond in ways they never imagined. 

Over the course of 15 years, Ocel and Shaka experience love, heartbreak, and growth—rising and falling as they search for who they are, both together and apart. 

In the end, will their love endure the passage of time, or will they find their own paths in letting go?

content.title: THAT TIME I GOT REINCARNATED AS A SLIME THE MOVIE: TEARS OF THE AZURE SEA
content.player: Miho Okasaki, Akane Kumada, Anzu Haruno
content.synopsis:
Kaien is an undersea nation whose people worship the Water Dragon as their guardian deity. Their ancestors lived among other clans on the surface long ago, but after wandering the earth in search of a land of peace and stability, they were blessed by the Water Dragon with a kingdom free of conflict. 

However, that peace would not last forever. Yura, the priestess who prays to the long-dormant Water Dragon, learns that someone is plotting to invade the surface in order to wake the Water Dragon, so she takes the flute that has been passed down in her clan for generations and heads for the surface to seek aid. When she arrives, she finds herself on a resort island in the domain of Elmesia, empress of the Sorcerous Dynasty of Thalion, and she meets Rimuru and his compatriots, who are enjoying a brief vacation after concluding their Nation's Opening Festival. Rimuru’s gang accepts Elmesia‘s request to accompany Yura to Kaien so they can help, but a conspiracy is already brewing under the sea... 

After the Water Dragon is awakened and turmoil breaks out over the flute, Yura’s hidden power comes to light. Can Rimuru and company protect the azure sea from the approaching threat and restore peace to Kaien?

content.title: TIBA TIBA SETAN
content.player: Oki Rengga, Lolox, Ratu Felisha, Tanta Ginting, Poppy Sovia, Reza  Nangin, Amara Angelica, Shahabi Sakri, Naura Hakim
content.synopsis: Chaos erupts when a brother and sister arrive in a old abandoned hotel where they believe their father has hidden a treasure for them not knowing that one of the sibling hired the care taker to pretend to be a ghost to get rid of them. but without them knowing, the care taker has awaken an the spirit a woman who was murdered and burried at the hotel and ends up haunting them. now all of them are victims and have to find a way to survive the terror.

content.title: GUDANG MERICA
content.writer: Imam Darto, Sesa Nasution, Warman Nasution
content.player: Ardhito Pramono, Fatih Unru, Zulfa Maharani, Arla Ailani, Benidictus Siregar, Rizky Inggar
content.synopsis:
At the quiet Harapan Ayah Hospital, Razi (Ardhito Pramono) blends in with three medical students undergoing their clinical rotations. What initially seems like routine night shifts gradually turns into a series of terrifying experiences after an unidentified patient dies under their care.

Strange occurrences begin to emerge—shadows, unsettling sounds, and the presence of a horrifying figure. The situation reaches its peak when the patient’s body mysteriously disappears from their watch.

Caught between medical logic and the fear of the unexplainable, they are forced to confront a mystery that slowly reveals a truth far greater than they ever imagined.

content.title: STAR WARS: THE MANDALORIAN AND GROGU
content.producer: Ian Bryce, Jon Favreau, Kathleen Kennedy
content.writer: Jon Favreau, Dave Filoni, Noah Kloor
content.player: Pedro Pascal, Sigourney Weaver, Martin Scorsese, Jeremy Allen White, Jonny Coyne, Dave Filoni, Steve Blum, Hemky Madera, Paul Sun-Hyung Lee
content.synopsis: The evil Empire has fallen, and Imperial warlords remain scattered throughout the galaxy. As the fledgling New Republic works to protect everything the Rebellion fought for, they have enlisted the help of legendary Mandalorian bounty hunter Din Djarin and his young apprentice Grogu.

content.title: GOHAN
content.director: Chayanop Boonprakob, Atta Hemwadee, Nattawut Poonpiriya
content.writer: Chayanop Bunprakob, Nattawut Poonpiriya, Atta Hemwadee
content.player: Jinjett Wattanasin, Tontawan Tantivejakul, Chatchai Chinnasri, Yasushi Kitajima, Ohmi Ryota , Poe Mamhe Thar
content.synopsis:
Sepuluh tahun, satu ekor anjing liar, dan empat jiwa yang kesepian 
 
"Selama sepuluh tahun, seekor anjing liar perlahan masuk ke dalam kehidupan seorang pensiunan insinyur Jepang, seorang asisten rumah tangga migran, dan sepasang kekasih yang saling menjauh. Ikatan tak terduga ini menjadi sebuah perjalanan menyentuh tentang cinta, kesembuhan, dan harapan." 

Dari pembuat How to Make Millions Before Grandma Dies, bersiaplah untuk sebuah perjalanan tentang bagaimana cinta tak harus bicara, tapi bisa menyembuhkan segalanya.

content.title: TUMBAL PROYEK
content.player: Callista Arum, Kiesha Alvaro, Karina Suwandi, Eduwart Manalu, Fuad Idris, Adi Sudirja, Agus Firmansyah, Rendi Khrisna, Raffan Al Aryan
content.synopsis: Di tengah proyek jembatan terbesar yang menghubungkan dua wilayah, nyawa demi nyawa menghilang di balik pembangunannya. Yuda (Kiesha Alvaro), bersama adiknya (Callista Arum) dan ibunya (Karina Suwandi), menyusup ke dalam sebuah perusahaan konstruksi tempat ayah mereka tewas untuk membuktikan bahwa tumbal proyek itu nyata.

content.title: SEMUA AKAN BAIK-BAIK SAJA
content.player: Reza Rahadian, Christine Hakim, Raihaanun, Ari Irham, Happy Salma, Aquene Djorghi, Malika Shaquina, Alim
content.synopsis:
The sudden death of Happy Salma’s character, Mentari, becomes a storm that forces three siblings whose lives have taken very different paths to reunite under one roof. Langit (Reza Rahadian), a man hardened by life on the streets, must now carry the burden of stepping into a parental role for Tari’s three children left behind. 

However, Langit’s return is met with cold resistance from Malika (Aquene Djorghi), the eldest, a gifted musician weighed down by emotional wounds and distrust. Beyond Malika, Langit must also face Shaffa (Shaffa Almira), who is struggling through a fragile phase of adolescence, and Alim, the youngest child with special needs who becomes a target of bullying at school. 

Amid conflicts over inheritance and values sparked by Ilham (Teuku Rifnu Wikana), Tari’s ex-husband, Langit and his siblings Bintang (Raihaanun), who harbors a dark secret, and Banyu (Ari Irham), who is trapped in the illusion of the digital world must set aside their egos. Under the gentle guidance of Ibu Wida (Christine Hakim), they come to understand that loss is sometimes the only way to truly find one another again and to prove that, for a family, everything will eventually be alright.
